replies.author: Acceqted
replies.body:
Looks decent. A couple tips would be:

  • It'a dangerous to have the monuments in a cave since those who enjoy defending wouldn't find it usual.
  • The place where everyone would fight seems a little small but the gameplay will be interesting.
Good luck :^).

replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
Good job with the map but I think you should make some changes. For example, Make the void gap bigger as at the moment it's just a simple blockplace across, you could maybe add a broken bridge on it? just an idea.
I recommend you make the base of the island thicker (http://imgur.com/a/Tqp5x) so that it's easier for tunnellers.
Remove some of the trees and replace them with bushes or something, they're just boring and too simple(for me atleast). Adding onto that, make the whole thing wider by around 10ish blocks as it looks too small for a public map.
Keep up the good work,
-Ryan

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Your map has been denied by the Map Developers for the following reasons.

-Monument places: In such a small cave area, it makes it a very bad place for defenders to try to defend.

-Size: Since you have one lane you need to make it a wider lane so that pvp is not stuck in the mid.

You may submit once you have made these edits.
